name: observability-plan
description: Design an observability plan for a service — user-journey SLIs, SLOs with error budgets, symptom-based burn-rate alerting (page vs ticket, every page actionable and runbook-linked), and a deliberate metrics/logs/traces split with a cardinality and cost budget. Use when the user needs SLOs, alerting design, a monitoring/observability strategy, dashboards, or wants to fix alert fatigue and know what to measure.

handoff.when: the alerts are defined and each needs a procedure
handoff.purpose: Write the procedure the on-call follows per alert.
handoff.fallback: If runbook-generator is absent, write one numbered procedure per alert inline.

handoff.when: detection fired and an audience needs telling
handoff.purpose: Communicate at the stage the incident is actually in.
handoff.fallback: If incident-comms is absent, state the stage, the impact, and the next update time inline.

model.rationale: Methodology synthesis against fixed SRE practices (golden signals, burn-rate alerting, pillar split). SLO calibration needs judgment but is bounded; escalate via ambiguous-input on contested reliability targets.
